messages:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: rolling maintenance for inference runtime tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll do staged restarts on dedicated pools, no DB changes. Expect brief 10-30s request drops per host. tagging: @channel

maggie: Thanks. Are we aiming for an automatic fallback to a smaller model if a host doesn't come back?

raj: yes — plan is: primary runtime v1.42 -> shard restarts -> route to v1.41 fallback on failure. We'll pin v1.41 for the duration. If >5% errors across a pool we trigger rollback.

liam: Support playbook? What do we push to Statuspage and customers?

carla: Drafted two short comms below. Please review, we should keep language non-technical and include ETA + impact windows.

carla: STATUSPAGE BLURB (component: API / Inference runtime):

 - "We will perform scheduled maintenance on our inference runtime on 2026-04-08 from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC. During this window some API requests may see brief errors or slightly increased latency as traffic is rerouted. No customer data changes are expected. We will post updates here and on our status@redwood.com list."

carla: EMAIL/SUPPORT TEMPLATE:

Subject: Planned maintenance: inference runtime — 2026-04-08 02:00–04:00 UTC

Hi <customer>,

We will be performing a brief scheduled maintenance of Redwood's inference runtime on 2026-04-08 from 02:00–04:00 UTC. During the window you may notice short request failures (typically 10–30s) or small latency increases as traffic is shifted to fallback model variants. No data migrations or customer configuration changes are needed.

If you have strict SLOs during that window and want us to delay, reply to this message or contact support. Otherwise no action is required.

Thanks,
Redwood Support

maggie: Nice — add link to status page and a note about rollback policy: "We will rollback to previous runtime version if errors exceed threshold."

carla: Updated templates to include rollback sentence and contact link. Also added a short engineering note for the release doc (internal):

ENG RELEASE NOTE (internal):
 - Window: 2026-04-08 02:00–04:00 UTC
 - Targets: dedicated pools in us-west-2, eu-west-1 (staggered by region)
 - Steps: drain -> restart host -> healthcheck -> un-drain -> monitor 15m
 - Fallback: route to v1.41 if host fails healthcheck after 3 attempts
 - Rollback trigger: >5% 5xx across pool sustained for 10 minutes
 - Post-checks: sample generation QA (prompt bank quick-run) + latency sweep

raj: One operational note: we'll disable autoscaling during each pool's restart window to avoid noisy scale events. Also captured a quick Statuspage JSON we can paste to the API:

support-bot: {"status":"scheduled","components":[{"id":"api-inference","name":"Inference API","status":"maintenance"}],"scheduled_for":"2026-04-08T02:00:00Z","scheduled_until":"2026-04-08T04:00:00Z","description":"Rolling runtime maintenance. Brief request disruptions possible."}

liam: For support: add canned triage steps:
 - Check status.redwood.com first
 - If customer reports 5xx, confirm region and check pool health in console
 - If >1 customer in region affected escalate to infra on-call

carla: Also proposed timeline for customer notifications:
 - 48h before: email + statuspage scheduled maintenance
 - 2h before: statuspage imminent + in-app banner for affected tenants
 - At start: statuspage update + one-liner tweet (if public)
 - Post: summary + SLO impact in incident log if any

maggie: Approving this copy. raj, can you add the model-pin instruction to the rollout script (pin v1.41 until 04:15 UTC)?

raj: yes, I'll add pin + auto-unpin at 04:15 unless we trigger rollback.

liam: I'll prep the support broadcast and paste the email template into Intercom sequences.

carla: I'll publish the statuspage JSON and schedule the 48h email.

maggie: Final Q: do we need to notify Dedicated customers with dedicated IP/VPC separately?

raj: Yes — for Dedicated we will open support tickets to each account with recommended maintenance window opt-out. I'll pull the list and send today.

maggie: Cool. Marking as ready. If anything changes, update this thread and I'll coordinate external comms. :thumbsup:
